highlights: A new opt-in setting can remove Ignifire's managed local copy only after both the audio file and cloud library snapshot are confirmed saved.
Tracks and albums downloaded from the cloud are now pinned to this PC so automatic cleanup cannot remove them.
Removing a cloud download clears its local pin and returns playback to cloud streaming.
notes: Adds confirmed post-upload local cleanup and persistent per-track download pins, while preserving original import sources and manually retained downloads.
